content_sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad
IoT-Enabled Smart Atmospheric Water and Carbon Capture System Using Ultrasound-Regenerated Hybrid Sorbents for Urban Sustainability
Council of Science & Technology, Uttar Pradesh (CSTUP)
Junior Research Assistant / Senior Research Assistant / Research Associate (JRA/SRA/RA)
28, 32, and 35 years (as per JRA/SRA/RA) as on 01 April 2026

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian nationals and residents of Uttar Pradesh. The essential and desirable qualifications vary by the level of appointment as specified below: Junior Research Assistant (JRA): Bachelor of Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) or equivalent degree with high academic attainment and 1st class in graduate and postgraduate examination. Senior Research Assistant (SRA): 1st class M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree, or M.Sc. / M.Sc. (Ag.) / M. Pharm. / M.V.Sc. with high academic attainment and at least two years of research experience after M.Sc. as evident from published papers in reputed journals. Research Associate (RA): Minimum Ph.D. or equivalent degree, or M.Tech. / M.E. / M.D. with three years of research, design, and development experience. Desirable Experience: Candidates having relevant experience in heat and mass transfer, adsorption, atmospheric water harvesting, carbon capture, thermal systems, experimental research, instrumentation, IoT-based systems, or related areas will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹28,000/- per month on a consolidated basis. Accommodation may be available subject to availability and Institute norms. Selected candidates may be permitted to register for a Ph.D. programme at MNNIT Allahabad subject to fulfilling eligibility requirements and applicable Institute rules. Leave and other benefits are applicable as per project staff guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website or project notification pages. Fill out the application form completely with correct details. Compile scanned copies of supporting documents including educational certificates, date of birth proof, category certificate, and experience certificate. Send the completed application and attachments by email to [email protected] and [email protected] . Use the exact subject line: “Application for JRA/SRA/RA (on Contract) – Project ID 8483”. Ensure the application reaches on or before 21 October 2026 by 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit, qualifications, experience, and project requirements. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the date and mode of interview. Shortlisted candidates must appear for the interview with an updated CV, publications if any, original certificates and mark sheets, and one set of self-attested photocopies of supporting documents. Employed candidates must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, initially made for a period of one year and extendable further based on satisfactory performance and fund availability.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and is there any relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limits are 28 years for JRA, 32 years for SRA, and 35 years for RA as on 01 April 2026. The upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC, PwD, and women candidates as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit, qualifications, experience, and the specific requirements of the project. Shortlisted applicants will be notified via email regarding the interview date and mode.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required email subject line for submitting the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must use the exact subject line “Application for JRA/SRA/RA (on Contract) – Project ID 8483” when emailing their application documents.
